msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia playfitness-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Sports nutrition campaign still life of a large black tub of micellar casein protein with a pink and white label from the reference, on a clean concrete plinth in a bright modern gym. The product stands in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Crisp daylight, energetic and premium. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage.
